{{Vanilla|Wheat Seeds}}

{{Infobox auto}}

'''Wheat grain''' is the seed of wheat and the base of [[flour]]. It replaces {{MCW|Wheat Seeds|wheat seeds}}: planting it grows wheat, and 3 grain grind into 1 flour.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/flour.json}}</ref> In the early game it is found by breaking grass with a hoe.

== Obtaining ==

=== Breaking grass ===
Short grass broken with a hoe has a 1 in 8 chance to drop wheat grain (Fortune adds to the count, not the chance); otherwise it drops itself. Without a hoe or shears it drops nothing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/short_grass.json}}</ref>

=== Farming ===
A fully grown wheat crop drops 1 [[straw]] and 1 to 4 grain, as vanilla wheat drops seeds. The grain comes from one of two equally likely entries, one increased by Fortune and the other by the Electrum tool intrinsic, so each bonus applies to about half of the harvests. An unripe crop drops 1 grain.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/wheat.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

Picking up wheat grain unlocks the [[flour]] recipe. Two grain also go into [[Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|apple cinnamon oatmeal]]. Wheat grain can be planted and fed to chickens as in vanilla.
